# laravelforge_site_domain_nginx (Resource)

Manages the per-domain nginx configuration block on a Laravel Forge site. Singleton per domain record (PUT update only, no separate create/destroy).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Nginx configuration block to apply for the domain.
- `domain_record_id` (Number) ID of the domain record whose nginx config this manages.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site the domain record belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) Current nginx configuration content as reported by Forge.
